GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 015 (10 Jan 47) LS-L
(SCAPIN - 1453)
APO 500
10 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Criminal Jurisdiction over United Nations Nationals.
1. Reference CLO No. 5774 (CJ), 30 October 1946, subject: Criminal Jurisdiction over United Nations nationals, inclosing a report of seven criminal cases involving nine United Nations nationals, that had been appealed prior to 19 February 1946.
2. Disposition of these cases is directed as follows:
a. The two cases transferred to the jurisdiction of occupation courts will be considered closed.
b. The three cases in which the defendants have been acquitted will be considered closed.
c. In the case of Ho Chin Kang (Ka Kin Ko), the unexecuted portion of the sentence will be suspended and the defendant will be deported to China. The suspension of the sentence will be effective upon deportation.
d. In the case of Yang Kuo Hsun (Yo Koku Kin), the unexecuted portion of the sentence and fine will be remitted.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
